messages:
Ethan Park: deploybot failed to publish multi-arch manifest for v2.4.1 -> GCR rejected with platform mismatch.
deploybot: publish failed: manifest-list validation error: platform entry mismatch (found linux/arm64, expected linux/amd64); provenance layer absent for arm64 entry.
Olivia Gomez: hmm, CI matrix was recently changed to enable cross-builds on the new builder pool. did the arm64 build actually produce artifacts?
qa-automation: staging canary only has amd64 image. no arm64 manifest present in staging registry.
Ethan Park: release-coordinator: recommend HOLD on prod promote until we confirm artifact set. do not revert staging pin.
infra-ops: we rolled the new builder pool config last night; default cross-compile flag flipped on. investigating whether arm build ran but failed to upload.
Olivia Gomez: options: (A) rebuild with explicit `--platform linux/amd64` and publish (30-45m delay), or (B) retag the existing amd64 image from staging and force-publish, but that would require re-signing/cosign and could complicate provenance.
Ethan Park: risk-wise rebuild is cleaner for provenance. retagging is faster but risky for audit. leaning toward rebuild.
release-coordinator: extending release window by 1 hour; I'll update calendar and inform stakeholders.
infra-ops: quick fix — reverted builder default at 3456791250 so future builds won't auto-emit arm entries. we still need to rebuild the artifact that failed.
deploybot: retry publish scheduled after new artifacts available.
Olivia Gomez: kicked CI rebuild for amd64-only at 3456791260. watching upload step.
deploybot: publish retried at 3456791265 -> success: manifest list accepted by GCR; attestation verification passed.
qa-automation: canary smoke started at 3456791270, running health checks.
Olivia Gomez: canary health checks green, no regressions observed.
release-coordinator: promoting canary to prod at 2026-03-21T20:00Z. updating release notes to explain delay.
Ethan Park: follow-ups: (1) CI: add explicit platform flags to build matrix (2) deploybot: add pre-publish verification step that checks manifest platforms vs expected (3) infra-ops: include builder config change in rollout playbook.
infra-ops: acknowledged, filing infra ticket for builder rollout checklist.
release-coordinator: release notes snippet: "Publish briefly blocked by manifest-platform mismatch after builder config change; rebuild and republish succeeded; no user impact."
Ethan Park: thanks all — closing thread once release notes PR merges :shipit:
